name: Larsa
source:
Larsa (Renameble) is a tough tomboy who doesn't want to show any weakness. As the swabbie of the crew, her job is to tirelessly mop the deck every single day. Life on board a pirate ship is strange to get used to. It doesn't help that her crewmates are weirdos.
[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2202500/Rapscallions_On_Deck__A_Friendship_Otome/]Steam[/url]]
